quests.name: A Threat Within
quests.text: Speak with Marshal McBride.

quests.name: Simple Letter
quests.text: Read the Simple Letter and speak to Llane Beshere in Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Consecrated Letter
quests.text: Read the Consecrated Letter and speak to Brother Sammuel in Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Encrypted Letter
quests.text: Read the Encrypted Letter and speak to Jorik Kerridan in the stable behind Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Hallowed Letter
quests.text: Read the Hallowed Letter and speak to Priestess Anetta in Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Glyphic Letter
quests.text: Read the Glyphic Letter and speak to Khelden Bremen inside Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Tainted Letter
quests.text: Read the Tainted Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle next to Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Welcome!
quests.text: Bring the Northshire Gift Voucher to Merissa Stilwell.

quests.name: A Scribbled Letter
quests.text: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: White Stallion Exchange
quests.text: If you bring me your white stallion, I'll trade you for one from the new herd. The new horse will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the swift steeds here to see what it will look like.  MUST PAY 500 Gold too....

quests.name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
quests.text: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.

quests.name: Wolves Across the Border
quests.text: Bring 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat to Eagan Peltskinner outside Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Eagan Peltskinner
quests.text: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

quests.name: Nibbled-On Book
quests.text: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

quests.name: Rascally Rodents
quests.text: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.

quests.name: Book Inventory
quests.text: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.

quests.name: Investigate Echo Ridge
quests.text: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.

quests.name: Mining Consultant
quests.text: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

quests.name: The Big Picture
quests.text: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.

quests.name: The Stolen Tome
quests.text: Retrieve the Powers of the Void for Drusilla La Salle.

quests.name: Follow That Kobold!
quests.text: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

quests.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
quests.text: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

quests.name: Brotherhood of Thieves
quests.text: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Milly Osworth
quests.text: Speak with Milly Osworth.

quests.name: Milly's Harvest
quests.text: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Grape Manifest
quests.text: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: In Favor of the Light
quests.text: Speak to Priestess Josetta in Elwynn Forest.

quests.name: Garments of the Light
quests.text: Find Guard Roberts and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.

quests.name: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
quests.text: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Report to Goldshire
quests.text: Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: Rest and Relaxation
quests.text: Speak with Innkeeper Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.

quests.name: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
quests.text: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Book Return
quests.text: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

quests.name: The Great Outdoors
quests.text: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

quests.name: Camping 101: Cooking
quests.text: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.

quests.name: The Adventurer
quests.text: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.

quests.name: Camping 101: Alchemy
quests.text: Speak with Alchemist Mallory in Elwynn Forest near Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
quests.text: Speak with Smith Argus in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Enchanting
quests.text: Speak with Betty Quin in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Engineering
quests.text: Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: First Aid
quests.text: Speak with Michelle Belle in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Fishing
quests.text: Speak with Lee Brown near Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Herbalism
quests.text: Speak with Herbalist Pomeroy in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
quests.text: Speak with Adele Fielder in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Mining
quests.text: Speak with Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Skinning
quests.text: Speak with Helene Peltskinner in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Tailoring
quests.text: Speak with Eldrin in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Back to Billy
quests.text: Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Billy Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards.

quests.name: Lost Necklace
quests.text: Speak with Billy Maclure.

quests.name: Pie for Billy
quests.text: Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat to Auntie Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield's Farm.

quests.name: Young Lovers
quests.text: Give Maybell's Love Letter to Tommy Joe Stonefield.

quests.name: Note to William
quests.text: Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.

quests.name: Speak with Gramma
quests.text: Speak with Gramma Stonefield.

quests.name: Rare Books
quests.text: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

quests.name: Kobold Candles
quests.text: Bring 8 Large Candles to William Pestle in Goldshire.

quests.name: Shipment to Stormwind
quests.text: Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the Stormwind Trade District.

quests.name: Gold Dust Exchange
quests.text: Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire. Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in Elwynn Forest.

quests.name: The Fargodeep Mine
quests.text: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: A Net Disaster
quests.text: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.

quests.name: Slimy Menace
quests.text: Kill 7 Murlocs and 4 Murloc Streamrunner at Crystal Lake, then return to Jason Mathers.

quests.name: A Man About a Murloc
quests.text: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.

quests.name: An Enticing Offer
quests.text: Collect 6 Vials of Animal Blood and 18 Duskweed Petals for murloc bait, then return to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.

quests.name: Baited for Success
quests.text: Return to Jason Mathers.

quests.name: Bottles and Baubles
quests.text: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.

quests.name: Collecting Kelp
quests.text: Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to William Pestle in Goldshire.

quests.name: The Escape
quests.text: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.

quests.name: An Enchanting Lesson
quests.text: Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.  Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.

quests.name: Good Steel
quests.text: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.

quests.name: Goldtooth
quests.text: Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.

quests.name: Rough Wolf Pelts
quests.text: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.

quests.name: Delicate Instruments
quests.text: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

quests.name: Red Linen Goods
quests.text: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

quests.name: A Bundle of Trouble
quests.text: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

quests.name: Princess Must Die!
quests.text: Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.

quests.name: The Jasperlode Mine
quests.text: Explore the Jasperlode Mine, then report back to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty
quests.text: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.

quests.name: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!
quests.text: Go to the Westbrook Garrison and speak with Deputy Rainer.

quests.name: Further Concerns
quests.text: Marshal Dughan wants you to speak with Guard Thomas.

quests.name: Find the Lost Guards
quests.text: Guard Thomas wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.

quests.name: Deliver Thomas' Report
quests.text: Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: A Fishy Peril
quests.text: Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: Discover Rolf's Fate
quests.text: Search the murloc village for Rolf, or signs of his death.

quests.name: Bounty on Murlocs
quests.text: Bring 8 Torn Murloc Fins to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.

quests.name: Protect the Frontier
quests.text: Kill 8 Prowlers and 5 Young Forest Bears, and then return to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.

quests.name: Cloth and Leather Armor
quests.text: Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.

quests.name: Report to Thomas
quests.text: Deliver Rolf and Malakai's Medallions to Guard Thomas at the eastern Elwynn bridge.

quests.name: The Collector
quests.text: Go to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire and give him The Collector's Schedule.

quests.name: Manhunt
quests.text: Find and kill "the Collector" then return to Marshal Dughan with The Collector's Ring.

quests.name: Delicate Instruments
quests.text: Kill 8 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

quests.name: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
quests.text: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.

quests.name: Downstream
quests.text: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.

quests.name: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle
quests.text: Talk to Gryan Stoutmantle. He usually can be found in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road, in the middle of Westfall.

quests.name: A Warrior's Training
quests.text: Speak with Harry Burlguard.

quests.name: Dead-tooth Jack
quests.text: Retrieve Haggard's Badge from Dead-tooth Jack's camp, and return to Marshal Haggard.

quests.name: Gakin's Summons
quests.text: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

quests.name: Speak with Jennea
quests.text: Speak with Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.

quests.name: Seek out SI: 7
quests.text: Deliver Keryn Sylvius's package to Master Mathias Shaw at the Stormwind Barracks.

quests.name: Returning Home
quests.text: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.

quests.name: Desperate Prayer
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

quests.name: Divine Grace
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

quests.name: Training the Beast
quests.text: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.

quests.name: Confounding Flash
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

quests.name: WANTED: "Hogger"
quests.text: Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his Huge Gnoll Claw to Marshal Dughan.

quests.name: Croaky's Head
quests.text: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.

quests.name: Elmpaw's Head
quests.text: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.

quests.name: Tome of Divinity
quests.text: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Tome of Divinity
quests.text: Retrieve a Defias Script from the Defias Rogue Wizards in Elwynn, and return to Gazin Tenorm in Stormwind.

quests.name: Report to Jennea
quests.text: Speak with Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.

quests.name: SI:7
quests.text: Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."

quests.name: Your First Horse
quests.text: Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.

quests.name: Learning to Ride
quests.text: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Randal Hunter.

quests.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
quests.text: Travel to the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest and seek out your fortune.
